title: One Time Separate Instance Launch Funnel

source_statements.source_statement: Same repo, separate One Time Railway project/service/database/provider secrets, explicit promote policy.
Use join.onetimeonetime.com and do not touch onetimeonetime.com apex/root.
Consolidate join/member/fallback/legacy/BNA host routing.
Build One Time black/yellow landing/signup funnel and Start 30 Days Free offer.
Signup creates/updates scoped contact/member and grants 30 days free access immediately.
Member/classroom includes live, videos/replays, questions, parent/student/member basics.
Attendance v1 is automatic link click tracking, no manual attendance.
Zoom link is member-gated and not public.
Confirmation/reminder emails use suppression and no bulk sends.
First campaign packet uses join URL and approved imported One Time lead segment only.
WhatsApp maps Wappy to Whapi/WAPI with no real sends.
Buffer/social remains draft/approve only.
Drive is intake/drop and Vimeo is host/player.
Rabbi Stripe account, $67/month, sandbox/test first, payment success grants access.
Existing paying users are audited/migrated, not canceled.
Operations tasks newest-first with workspace/owner filters and scoped visibility.
Tests, screenshots, deploy/live-smoke, source coverage, stale evidence, secrets audit, diff check.
Hard guardrails: no secrets, bulk send, WhatsApp real sends, live Stripe, apex DNS, deletes, cancellations, GHL, data mixing.
Create raw intake, register, decisions, and Product Quality/Ramble v3 gates.
Run generated/unblocked runnable packets automatically unless blocked by live send/payment/DNS/provider/account/credential/privacy constraints.
Separate One Time Railway project/service and separate database are preferred while staying in the same GitHub repo/codebase.
join.onetimeonetime.com is the temporary campaign/launch domain; do not touch apex/root onetimeonetime.com yet.
New launch signups get 30 days free from signup and free signup grants access automatically.
Member/parent/student portal v1 includes schedule, gated class link, clicked attendance/progress, video/replays, and private questions with no chatbot or public student-to-student posting.
Attendance v1 is automatic class-link click tracking with no manual attendance.
Zoom link is not public; it is member-gated, click-tracked, and rotatable later.
Send test/seed email to sdratler@gmail.com only when the final live link is ready; no bulk campaign now.
Whapi/WAPI is the WhatsApp direction and Wappy maps to Whapi/WAPI unless repo evidence changes.
Drive is intake/drop, Vimeo is hosting/player, OBS may save to Drive, failed media upload creates internal task and email/alert to sdratler@gmail.com.
Rabbi uses his own Stripe account; one product after free period is $67/month; Stripe payment success grants/extends access automatically.
No secrets, bulk send, real WhatsApp to contacts, live Stripe, paid-user cancellation, hard delete, apex/root DNS mutation, BNA/One Time data mixing, private evidence exposure, or GHL.
Shloimie authorizes Codex to keep working and run every safe runnable packet without asking again.
Clean/reconcile the current worktree, preserve and commit real launch/unblocker work where safely stageable.
Provision/apply One Time Railway/project/database setup only if scripts and exact targets are present.
Use sdratler@gmail.com for seed/test email and internal failure alerts after final live links exist.
Send exactly one safe WhatsApp setup message to Rabbi only if Rabbi phone and configured sending provider are available.
Create exact GoDaddy DNS instructions for join.onetimeonetime.com and keep apex/root untouched.
Convert every remaining external blocker into exact top visible tasks.
No bulk campaign, live Stripe payment, paid-user cancellation, apex/root DNS mutation, hard delete, secret exposure, GHL runtime, or privacy-sensitive export.
